scope_interpretation.user_authorization_interpreted_as: Proceed phase by phase from authoritative source evidence to historical engineering replay and actual forward evidence, then to preregistered comparison, paper, and only after independent gates to a separately owner-approved minimal canary.
authorization_does_not_mean: permission to bypass an unavailable proxy
permission to fetch market rows before D0
permission to relabel historical archive timestamps as true received_at or available_at
permission to overwrite or recover the active G1 package
permission to bundle D0, D1, D2, D3, E2, paper, deployment, or live trading into this decision
permission to place orders or expose funds
scope_interpretation.current_p0: Create and validate a minimal, fully metered, official-source-document SD0 closure package with zero market-row body access.
scope_interpretation.current_safe_progress: Terra high may build and test the exact local SD0 allowlist now. Network execution remains fail-closed until the exact proxy preflight succeeds.

accepted_e0_gate.effect: E0 remains accepted only as local contract and synthetic fail-closed evidence. This route replaces neither its negative SD0 finding nor its D0 denial; it defines a new measurable way to close SD0.

active_g1_terminal_authority.effect: Terminal mathematical unreachability remains binding. Subsequent files cannot repair the frozen plan.

volatile_non_authoritative_snapshot.purpose: Operational awareness only; not a seal, authority, G1 recovery, cohort assignment, or permission input.
volatile_non_authoritative_snapshot.interpretation: Later observations do not repair the plan's terminal upper-bound proof. Because this package may still be written, this snapshot is volatile and must not be treated as a content-addressed data seal.

read_only_operational_audit.immutability_rule: No file under the active G1 root may be created, modified, deleted, renamed, copied out, or used by SD0. A future exact D1 decision may authorize a separately sealed, content-addressed read-only copy into a new evidence root, but it cannot relabel the data as recovered G1, calibration, or holdout.

route_decision.why_feasible: The source-authority gap can be closed without market-row bodies by using an exact, sequential, resource-metered client against a small fixed official-document and checksum/HEAD allowlist. The archive and actual-forward chronology limits can be kept in separate evidence lanes.
route_decision.current_blocker: The configured proxy endpoint has no observed listener, so no external SD0 request is presently measurable or executable under this route.

sd0_artifact_scope_rules.partial_run_semantics: Preserve receipts and report WAIT_DATA or FAIL_CLOSED. Do not retry under the same run ID.

sd0_source_contract.head_semantics: No response body is accepted. Any body byte is discarded and the run fails closed.
sd0_source_contract.get_semantics: A HEAD success with an acceptable declared content length is required before its paired GET. Streaming stops before exceeding the per-object cap; cap exceedance is FAIL_CLOSED.
source_authority_pass_conditions: All seven exact requests complete once in order with zero redirects and no fallback.
The complete request, response byte, elapsed, status, content-type, proxy, and error ledger is sealed.
README identifies the exact repository and exact supported archive layout used by the candidate.
The checksum sidecar contains exactly one syntactically valid SHA-256 digest bound to the exact ZIP basename.
The ZIP HEAD identifies a bounded nonzero content length within the future D0 compressed cap.
The stored documents and all receipts have physical SHA-256 identities.
No market-row body or ZIP body was requested or persisted.
License/terms evidence explicitly permits the intended download, local research retention, derived research artifacts, and intended jurisdiction, or the result remains WAIT_DATA_TERMS.
sd0_source_contract.license_rule: A repository software license alone must not be interpreted as a market-data reuse license. Ambiguity yields WAIT_DATA_TERMS and blocks D0.
sd0_source_contract.maximum_sd0_positive_claim: The exact source documents, checksum sidecar, and archive header metadata were retrieved under the declared request and resource caps without market-row body access. This does not establish data-row validity, point-in-time validity, backtest validity, expected value, profitability, or trading permission.

required_before_any_external_request: Workspace path, branch, and HEAD match this decision.
Every existing allowlisted output path that is expected to be new is absent.
No path resolves through a symlink.
The exact proxy TCP listener responds.
Available workspace disk is at least 15 GiB.
The standard-library client and its tests pass locally.
The request-plan canonical digest is recorded in the preflight artifact.
sd0_preflight_and_stop_rules.no_safe_external_action: Produce only the local preflight WAIT_DATA artifact and stop. Do not widen URLs, change proxies, use a browser, or access another source.

lane_har1_historical_archive_engineering.name: HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE_ENGINEERING_REPLAY
forbidden_claims: queue position or production fill quality
lane_har1_historical_archive_engineering.hard_rule: event_time must never be copied into, aliased as, or used as evidence for received_at or available_at.

lane_fcr1_forward_actual.name: FORWARD_CAPTURE_ACTUAL_AVAILABILITY
required_purpose: nonoverlapping development calibration and holdout cohorts
lane_fcr1_forward_actual.required_identity: A new immutable plan, source registry, collector digest, evidence root, cohort map, and separately sealed bundle authorized by a future Sol gate.
lane_fcr1_forward_actual.active_g1_treatment: The existing active G1 may only be admitted after a separate exact D1 decision and immutable seal as SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY. It cannot become recovered G1, calibration, holdout, or proof that the original plan passed.

cross_lane_rules: HAR1 and FCR1 artifacts, clocks, cohort roles, reports, and conclusions remain separately named.
HAR1 cannot backfill missing FCR1 received_at or available_at.
FCR1 cannot retroactively make HAR1 point-in-time.
Any mixed analysis reports each lane separately before an explicitly labeled sensitivity synthesis.
Only preassigned nonoverlapping FCR1 cohorts may support calibration, locked holdout, shadow, or paper claims.

required_before_new_sol_d0_decision: A separate Sol SD0 completion gate accepts the exact metered evidence.
Source ownership and document identity are explicit and content-addressed.
Terms and intended jurisdiction are explicitly closed without inference from a software-only license.
ZIP content length is known, nonzero, and within the compressed cap.
The official sidecar SHA-256 is syntactically and semantically bound to the exact ZIP basename.
Product, symbol, interval, timestamp unit, column schema, UTC boundary, and canonical row key are frozen.
Missing rows, duplicate rows, corrections, replacement objects, late publication, and delisting rules are frozen.
The chronology role is already consumed as SEEN_ENGINEERING_REPLAY_QA_ONLY before any market-row access.
A new content-addressed D0 evidence root and exact artifact allowlist are defined.
Disk and extraction resource preflight is demonstrated.
No active G1 path is an input or output.
future_d0_download_rules: Use the exact object URL only through the separately accepted metered client.
Stream to a create-once temporary object inside the new D0 evidence root.
Verify the official SHA-256 before atomic seal.
Do not extract before checksum acceptance.
Reject symlinks, absolute paths, traversal, encrypted members, unexpected member count, and decompression ratio above the frozen cap.
Persist acquisition receipt times and headers; do not invent historical receipt times.
conditional_d0_plan_contract.d0_completion_effect: At most one verified historical archive may become a HAR1 raw-admission candidate. D0 does not admit rows, authorize an adapter, authorize scoring, or establish true PIT.

D1_RAW_ADMISSION.required_input: A D0-verified HAR1 archive or an explicitly supplied, immutable, separately sealed FCR1 artifact plus a new exact Sol decision.
minimum_pass_evidence: Container and member checksums match.
Schema, timestamp units, interval alignment, coverage, duplicates, gaps, corrections, and replacement semantics are measured.
Every row has a stable source key and provenance.
Clock semantics and lane role are explicit.
No event_time-as-available_at alias is possible.
Any active G1 input is sealed after capture and labeled SEEN_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY.

D2_ADAPTER_AND_EVENT_REPLAY.required_input: D1 PASS and a new exact Sol D2 decision.
minimum_pass_evidence: Pure deterministic adapter and replay interface.
Gap, duplicate, correction, out-of-order, restart, and clock tests.
Content-addressed input-to-output reproducibility.
HAR1 assumed-delay grid remains separate from FCR1 actual arrival order.
No score, model selection, or trading action.

D3_DATASET_CONSTRUCTION.required_input: D2 PASS, frozen feature/action/label/state contracts, frozen cohort roles, and a new exact Sol D3 decision.
minimum_pass_evidence: Dataset construction only; no policy scoring while labels or gates can still change.
Point-in-time feature eligibility is machine checked.
Development, calibration, locked holdout, and actual-forward cohorts do not overlap.
HAR1 outputs remain engineering/sensitivity datasets and cannot occupy true-PIT calibration or holdout roles.
Insufficient episode or state coverage returns WAIT_DATA without lowering thresholds.

E2_FOUR_POLICY_COMPARISON.required_input: D3 PASS, preregistered metrics/costs/thresholds, frozen code and datasets, and a new exact Sol E2 decision.
minimum_pass_evidence: All four policies use identical eligible observations, costs, latency scenarios, splits, and risk budgets.
Report state/hypothesis metrics, Brier score, log loss, calibration, MFE, MAE, expected value after fees/slippage/funding, drawdown, tail loss, concentration, and bootstrap uncertainty.
Report HAR1 results only as reconstructed engineering/sensitivity evidence.
Any market-validity or predictive claim must come from an eligible actual-forward locked cohort.
Evidence-sufficient failure simplifies or rejects theory; it does not trigger feature expansion to rescue a result.

E3_SHADOW_PAPER_TESTNET.required_input: E2 PASS on eligible actual-forward evidence, independent risk/OMS contracts, and a new exact Sol E3 decision.
minimum_pass_evidence: Offline/live decision equivalence.
Duplicate intent, partial fill, reject, unknown order, disconnect, protection race, position-mode, reconciliation, and recovery drills pass.
Every open simulated/testnet position is protected or the system is in highest-severity halt/exit.
Zero unexplained order, fill, and position differences after reconciliation.
Paper/testnet evidence does not claim production liquidity, fill quality, or profitability.

G4A_LIVE_SAFETY_ADMISSION.required_input: Complete G3/E3 evidence plus a separately signed owner and Sol G4A decision.
minimum_external_conditions: Dedicated account or subaccount with account, collateral, orders, and BTCUSDT position exclusivity.
Withdrawal permission disabled at the venue and API-key level.
Exact production source SLA, stale-data actions, private stream, account reconciliation, collateral, halt, and exit policy.
Named human operator and monitoring window.
Funds owner signs all numeric limits and expiry.
G4A_LIVE_SAFETY_ADMISSION.effect_if_passed: Still E3; authorizes at most one separately defined M6B canary proposal, not an order.

M6B_LIMITED_CANARY.required_input: G4A PASS plus a separate exact owner-signed and Sol-authorized canary decision.
hard_rules: Stop when the first limit or expiry is reached.
No martingale, loss-chasing, leverage increase, online retuning, model replacement, capital expansion, or automatic extension.
Any critical data, protection, reconciliation, or permission anomaly halts new risk and returns to shadow/paper.
Run completion does not itself establish E4.

G4B_CANARY_EVIDENCE_REVIEW.required_input: A completed bounded M6B evidence package and a new Sol gate.

live_funds_hard_boundary.interpretive_rule: Research and engineering autonomy does not create authority over credentials, accounts, orders, funds, jurisdictional eligibility, or deployment.

currently_allowed: Build the exact SD0 local allowlist.
Run local synthetic and risk-driven tests.
Run the exact SD0 request plan only after every preflight condition passes.
Report WAIT_DATA without widening scope when the proxy or source contract fails.
currently_forbidden: Change this route or its allowlist.

invoke_only_when: SD0 package is complete and ready for its gate.
The same root cause remains unclosed for two Terra rounds.
An independent D0, D1, D2, D3, E2, E3, G4A, M6B, or G4B gate is ready.
A complete S0, G1, G2, or G3 phase is ready for stage review.
sol_ultra.not_for: Ordinary implementation, ordinary local test repair, slot polling, or routine data QA.

agent_and_route_management.dynamic_route_change_rule: A route change must be caused by explicit new evidence, preserve prior negative evidence, define exact changed permissions and artifacts, and receive a new Sol decision. Ordinary failure cannot silently widen sources, windows, thresholds, or claims.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: A feasible fail-closed successor route now exists: Terra high may build and locally test fourteen exact SD0 artifacts and may execute seven fixed, sequential, resource-metered official-source document/checksum/HEAD requests only after the configured proxy and all preflights pass. No market-row body, archive ZIP, active G1 data, raw admission, adapter, dataset, comparison, backtest, holdout, paper, deployment, order, credential, or fund permission is granted. Historical archives remain reconstructed engineering evidence only; true point-in-time progression requires a separately authorized actual-forward lane.
